summary: [Escalation] OpenAI-compatible API: streaming stalls (no tokens after first chunk) when tool calls enabled
description:
Issue summary:
- Escalation from enterprise account: streaming responses start (receives an initial chunk) then stall indefinitely. Client waits until it times out.
- Only occurs via OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with stream=true and tools=[...].

Impact:
- Moderate to high: breaks agent workflows that rely on tool calling; requires switching to non-streaming.

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) POST /v1/chat/completions
2) stream=true
3) include tools + tool_choice=auto
4) prompt that triggers at least one tool call

Investigation notes:
- Gateway log shows we emit the first SSE event, then internal state machine awaits a "final" message that never arrives.
- Hypothesis: we mishandle the tool_call delta shape for one provider adapter; we never send [DONE] nor flush subsequent deltas.

Workaround:
- Disable tools for streaming calls, or set stream=false.

Resolution:
- Patch to openai-compat tool delta mapping; add regression test for streaming tool calls.
comments: ava_chen (Support): Escalation from customer; they provided a curl repro. Adding it to the internal bug.

ethan_park (Eng-API): Fix landed in redwood#18507; waiting for deploy window.
